name: radar-chart
title: Radar chart
description: A radar chart fills in axis by axis as the camera circles it, then a second series springs open.

props.name: metrics
props.doc: The axes, clockwise from the top.

props.name: series
props.doc: The polygons. The first is the one the camera follows.

props.name: max
props.doc: The value at the outer ring.

props.name: palette
props.type: primary | monochrome | ocean | sunset | grove | vivid
props.doc: Chart palette: primary (indigo, yellow, fuchsia, mist, black), monochrome, ocean, sunset, grove or vivid.

props.name: axisSeconds
props.doc: How long the head takes along each edge of the first series.

props.name: holdSeconds
props.doc: How long the last frame holds.

props.name: camera.orbit
props.doc: How far the camera follows the head out from the centre.

props.name: camera.roll
props.doc: Degrees of roll the orbit leans into.

props.name: camera.motionBlur
props.doc: Strength of the motion blur on the fast moves; 0 turns it off.

props.name: camera.rackFocus
props.doc: Blur in pixels on labels away from the head.
